tex_dependency_audit.method: Static command scan with TeX comment stripping, balanced braces, optional arguments and explicit VLMo figw macro expansion. Local paths resolve relative to each TeX source directory; no compilation performed.

environment_dependencies.note: Packages, ctexart, XeLaTeX/latexmk and installed Windows fonts are environment dependencies, not original files; their installation/compilation has not been tested.
